notes:
- **Thinking modes**: choose None, Low, Normal or High under the message box. None answers straight away with a compact prompt, so a quick question costs a fraction of the tokens; High thinks it through and double-checks every file. Free includes None, Builder adds Low and Normal, Pro and up include all four.
- **Much smaller requests**: greetings and short questions no longer send your whole project context, and each mode sends only as much history and file list as it needs.
- **Build & Run and Texture Studio on Free**: watch one short ad on our website to unlock one Build & Run (including its automatic fixes) or five minutes of Texture Studio. The app itself never shows ads.
- **Much faster project opening**: long chat histories no longer freeze the window. The latest messages appear instantly and the assistant still remembers the whole conversation.
- **No more pause when you press Send**: messages appear in the chat right away, even in long conversations.
- **Proper taskbar icon**: MyCraftingAI now shows its own icon on the taskbar, in Alt+Tab and on pinned shortcuts.
- Java is no longer checked again on every message, and no console window flashes while it's checked.
